notes: Manufacturer spec sheet (Luminex "GigaCore Ethernet Switches Specifications" PDF) covers the 16Xt directly alongside the 12, 14R, and 16RFO variants — used as the primary authoritative source. Network ports are 10/100/1000 Mbps Neutrik EtherCON connectors (a ruggedized shielded RJ45 variant); mapped to connector id "rj45" since EtherCON is not in the allowed connector list. The 1x RJ45 expansion port is used for switch-to-switch stacking/expansion and is graded eth-1g like the other network ports. The 1x RJ45 serial console port is a management/control interface (not switched Ethernet) so no bandwidth grade was set. Backup power input (15VDC/2A) and backup PoE input (48VDC/2.1A) are physically Molex Micro-Fit 6-pin connectors — the closest allowed connector id is "dc-barrel," but the actual connector is a 6-pin Molex Micro-Fit, not a coaxial DC barrel jack; noted here as a caveat. PoE supply to the front EtherCON ports requires an optional external PoE power-supply module (LU 01 00051-GC14/16), delivering up to 160W total across the 10 front ports — this is supplied through the same network ports (not a separate physical port) so it is not listed as a separate port. Main AC power input is a standard IEC inlet with fuse holder, rated 100-240VAC 50-60Hz. Unit is 1U rack-mountable: 482 x 204.3 x 44 mm (19" x 8.04" x 1.73"). Product has since been discontinued (per third-party retailer note) and replaced by the GigaCore 20t, but this does not affect the historical spec accuracy for the 16Xt itself.
